infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: zerospike uses your camera to scan food barcodes and add meal photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: zerospike accesses your photo library to add photos to your meal journal.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: zerospike reads your blood glucose, insulin delivery and active-minute data from Apple Health to show them in your log and summaries.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: zerospike writes the blood glucose readings you enter by hand to Apple Health, only when you turn this on in Settings.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: zerospike can attach your current location to a message you send from the SOS screen, so someone can find you faster.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: zerospike lets you pick an emergency contact from your contacts for the SOS screen.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: zerospike does not collect motion data. A location component in the app references this permission; your movement is never tracked.
